label: 48V 24W gigabit passive PoE injector
description: Passive 48 VDC / 0.5 A (24 W) gigabit injector for Ubiquiti gear that expects always-on 48V on the spare pairs (older airMAX, UniFi APs, airFiber links). It is not 802.3af/at: there is no handshake, so a standards-compliant PD that waits for detection will never power up from it.
